reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E2 and E3 concern a different alloy system (Ti-Al-Cr-Nb-V-Zr) and show that Zr addition increases grain size, not refinement. E1 provides general HEA phase prediction criteria but no data on density reduction or high-temperature properties of HfMoTaTiZr with extra Zr. The premises are either unsupported or contradicted by the cited evidence.
premises: Adding Zr to HfMoTaTiZr will reduce density
Adding Zr will achieve solid solution strengthening
Adding Zr will maintain high strength and ductility at room temperature and ~1000 °C
Adding Zr will cause grain refinement
The alloy will remain a single BCC phase after Zr addition
